name: PubMed (NCBI E-utilities)
summary: NCBI's Entrez E-utilities over PubMed and the other NCBI databases: search, summaries, full records and links between records.

api_key.description: Optional NCBI API key (NCBI account > Settings > API Key Management); sent as the api_key query parameter, raising the limit from 3 to 10 requests per second.

notes: Free and keyless. Without a key more than 3 requests per second from one IP gets an error; a key allows 10 per second.
NCBI asks large jobs to run on weekends or between 9 PM and 5 AM US Eastern on weekdays, and to send tool and email parameters identifying the caller.
Answers are XML unless retmode=json, which esearch, esummary and einfo support; efetch does not return JSON.
The usual flow is search (IDs) then summary or fetch with those IDs.

endpoints.name: Search PubMed
endpoints.summary: PubMed IDs (or another database's UIDs) matching a query, or just the count.

db.description: Entrez database, e.g. pubmed, pmc, nlmcatalog, clinvar, gene, or gds (GEO datasets); pubmed.info lists them all.

term.description: Text query, like a PubMed search string; percent-encode special characters.

retstart.description: Offset of the first ID returned, default 0.

sort.description: PubMed: most recent (default), pub date, relevance, title, author, journal (spaces as +).

field.description: Restrict the whole term to one search field.

datetype.description: Date field for the date filters; for PubMed crdt, edat, pdat or mhda.

reldate.description: Only items dated within the last n days (by datetype).

mindate.description: Range start, YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY/MM or YYYY; needs maxdate.

maxdate.description: Range end, same formats; needs mindate.

notes: Returns IDs only; pass them to pubmed.summary or pubmed.fetch.

endpoints.name: Get document summaries
endpoints.summary: Title, authors, journal, dates and other summary fields for a list of UIDs.

db.description: Entrez database, e.g. pubmed, pmc, nlmcatalog, clinvar, gene, or gds (GEO datasets); pubmed.info lists them all.

id.description: One UID or a comma-separated list.

endpoints.name: Fetch full records
endpoints.summary: Full records (abstracts, MEDLINE or XML) for a list of UIDs.

db.description: Entrez database, e.g. pubmed, pmc, nlmcatalog, clinvar, gene, or gds (GEO datasets); pubmed.info lists them all.

id.description: One UID or a comma-separated list.

rettype.description: Record view, e.g. abstract, medline, docsum.

endpoints.name: Find linked records
endpoints.summary: Related articles, citing articles or records in other NCBI databases for given UIDs.

dbfrom.description: Database the input UIDs are from.

db.description: Entrez database, e.g. pubmed, pmc, nlmcatalog, clinvar, gene, or gds (GEO datasets); pubmed.info lists them all.

id.description: One UID or a comma-separated list.

cmd.description: neighbor (default), neighbor_score, neighbor_history, acheck, ncheck, lcheck, llinks, llinkslib or prlinks.

linkname.description: One link type, dbfrom_db_subset, e.g. pubmed_pubmed (similar articles).

term.description: Entrez query to filter the linked UIDs.

datetype.description: Date field for the date filters; for PubMed crdt, edat, pdat or mhda.

reldate.description: Only items dated within the last n days (by datetype).

mindate.description: Range start, YYYY/MM/DD, YYYY/MM or YYYY; needs maxdate.

maxdate.description: Range end, same formats; needs mindate.

retmode.description: xml (default), or ref to redirect to the provider site.
